strip.note: Scope stretches every phase after discovery - development most. It never adds a phase, reorders one, or skips a sign-off. Both ends come from our published price ranges; a flexible deadline or content written from scratch can stretch a quote to {ceiling} weeks, never further. Discovery counts as one day.
